newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga says government prepared to take unpopular decisions to solve ethnic problem and develop country devastated by civil war.
Judicial Service Commission interdicts magistrate and additional district judge facing allegations of rape.
LTTE suspects captured in Modera reveal rebel plans to attack important places in capital Colombo in January, police say.
Security forces kill two Tamil Tiger rebel suicide bombers trying to enter Trincomalee naval harbour.
Differences emerge in LTTE over escape by Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte and security forces chief in helicopter crash in LTTE-held Wanni.
